name: Tir Tairngiri
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: a name of the land of promise

text: Tir Tairngiri is a name of the land of promise in Irish myth. It is the home of Niamh, a queen of the fairies. She is the child of the ocean god Manannán. She keeps a fair land beyond the water, and mortals who reach it do not return.

okr.objective: Set down Tir Tairngiri as the land of promise in Irish myth.
key_results: Names it the land of promise
Names Niamh the queen who lives there
Notes the sea god her father
